verdicts.label: FALSE
verdicts.what_is_true_en: COVID-19 vaccines do not contain microchips for tracking people. Health authorities and fact-checkers have consistently debunked this claim, explaining that barcodes on vaccine packaging are for tracking distribution, not individuals.
verdicts.reasoning_en: An overwhelming body of evidence from multiple TIER_1 sources, including the Indonesian Ministry of Health (Kemenkes), Jala Hoaks Jakarta, Komdigi, and AFP Fact Check, explicitly and consistently refutes the claim that COVID-19 vaccines contain microchips for tracking people. These sources, along with TIER_2 and TIER_3 sources like Tempo.co and the Mayo Clinic, have repeatedly labeled this claim as a hoax or false. There is no credible evidence provided that supports the claim.
